summary: Real-code-cited root-cause evidence and direct compiled-binary proof for the speech-worker-thread decoupling fix.
trigger: Operator's real Windows report after a model was successfully installed: transcription active and audio arriving, but CIP slow/unresponsive, transcript text poor/repetitive, Intelligence Feed empty, and intermittent NO SIGNAL.

rootCauseCitations.audioCallbackInvokesSinkSynchronously: integrations/audio/src/lib.rs:316-336 - device.build_input_stream's closure calls sink(AudioChunk{...}) directly, on cpal's own real-time audio thread, no channel in between.
rootCauseCitations.sinkPreviouslyCalledHandleAudioChunkInli: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs (pre-fix): the sink closure in start_listening called handle_audio_chunk(&sink_app, service_id, chunk) directly - the ONE remaining audio consumer not already using the acoustic path's proven worker-thread pattern.
rootCauseCitations.whisperInferenceIsBlockingAndSynchronous: ai/speech/src/whisper.rs:38 (CHUNK_SAMPLES = 3.0s of audio) and :102-104 (state.full(params, &audio_f32) - whisper.cpp's real, synchronous CPU-bound call) - runs once per feed_audio call that crosses the buffer threshold.
rootCauseCitations.lockHeldAcrossInference: handle_audio_chunk acquired state.speech_engine.lock() and held it across the entire feed_audio call, including the blocking inference.
rootCauseCitations.sameLockNeededByPolledStatusCommand: get_live_status (commands.rs, ~line 5025) also locks state.speech_engine just to read is_ready() - and LiveChurchBrain.tsx:245 polls getLiveStatus() every STATUS_POLL_MS = 3000 (LiveChurchBrain.tsx:49) - the same cadence as CHUNK_SAMPLES's 3.0s inference window, so a poll landing during inference blocks on the mutex.
rootCauseCitations.acousticPathAlreadyUsesTheCorrectPattern: commands.rs's own pre-existing doc comment (now preserved) states the acoustic worker exists specifically so 'a slow/backed-up acoustic worker can never block the audio capture thread or the speech-engine feed right after it' - the speech path had never been given the same treatment until this phase.

sermonContentCrossDomainFinding.conclusion: Confirmed NOT wired to the live audio path at all - pipeline.rs's handle_final_transcript calls only cip_core_service::process_transcript_segment (Bible Intelligence). LiveChurchBrain.tsx's onTranscriptUpdated handler only appends to the displayed transcript list; analyzeSermonTranscript is only called from the manual Sermon text-entry path.
sermonContentCrossDomainFinding.scopeDecision: Confirmed pre-existing, documented (Phase 3.8's own ServiceReplay screen exists for exactly this reason) - explicitly out of scope for this phase, not a regression, not fixed here.

fixDesign.pattern: Mirrors spawn_acoustic_worker exactly - a dedicated std::thread::spawn loop reading AudioChunks from an mpsc channel until it closes.
fixDesign.channelChoice: Unbounded (mpsc::channel), unlike acoustic's bounded/try_send channel - dropping a chunk mid-Whisper-buffer would reintroduce an audio-corruption problem of a different shape; steady-state throughput is not at risk since per-chunk worker cost (resample + buffer-append) is far cheaper than real-time arrival except during the brief, bounded inference window.
fixDesign.audioCallbackNowDoes: downmix_to_i16, rms_level, two non-blocking channel sends (acoustic try_send + speech send) - no locks, no inference, no database access, no event emission.
fixDesign.unchanged: WhisperSpeechEngine's buffering window, resampling logic, Bible detection logic, database schema, event contracts - purely relocates where existing per-chunk work executes.
